in_sanskrit.name: त्रिधा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tridha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'tri' meaning three and 'dha' meaning quarters or parts. It denotes a person who is three-quarters or three-parts of something.

in_hindi.name: त्रिधा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Tridha is also the Hindi transcription of the Sanskrit name 'त्रिधा'. The name is derived from the words 'त्रि' meaning three and 'धा' meaning quarters or parts. It denotes a person who is three-quarters or three-parts of something.

in_tamil.name: திரிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Tridha's Tamil transcription is 'திரிதா'. The name is derived from the Tamil word 'திரு' meaning divine or sacred and 'வளர்' meaning to grow or expand. In the context of Tridha, the name can be interpreted as 'the one who grows or expands divinely' or 'the sacred one who is three-quarters or three-parts of something'.

in_telugu.name: త్రిధా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Tridha's Telugu transcription is 'త్రిధా'. The name is derived from the Telugu words 'తీ' meaning three and 'ధా' meaning quarters or parts. It denotes a person who is three-quarters or three-parts of something.

in_marathi.name: Tridha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tridha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Tridevi’, meaning three goddesses, Tridha is a beautiful and powerful name for a baby girl in the Hindu culture. This name is believed to bring the blessings of the three primary goddesses - Lakshmi, Saraswati, and Parvati, symbolizing prosperity, knowledge, and love respectively.
